subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Giving a tool is not enough.”?
options: People only need to slow down and read it.
People need commitment, not only clicks.
People need the power to keep it working.
People need quiet spaces before the world enters.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「People only need to slow down and read it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People need commitment, not only clicks.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Giving a tool is not enough. People need the power to keep it working.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「People need quiet spaces before the world enters.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Giving a tool is not enough. People need the power to keep it working.」，答案為「People need the power to keep it working.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「People need the power to keep it working.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
